    s') : s'.cfg.outgoing = s.cfg.outgoing

theorem cfgFlags_lookup (cfg lrn : GSet w64) (k : w64) : cfgFlags cfg lrn !! k = if k ∈ cfg then
    some false else if k ∈ lrn then some true else none

    1) (h0 : c.NodeId' ≠ W64 0) (hV : ¬c.NodeId' ∈ V) (hne : V ≠ ∅) (Hd : ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ L → ¬k ∈

def cfgState (cfg lrn : GSet w64) : CCState :=
  { cfg := cfgM cfg lrn, prs := cfgFlags cfg lrn }

    V L) = cfgFlags V <[id := ()]>L

theorem gset_mem_insert (V : GSet w64) (id k : w64) : k ∈ <[id := ()]>V ↔ k = id ∨ k ∈ V

    some (cfgState V <[id := ()]>L)

theorem clearAutoLeave_cfgState (cfg lrn : GSet w64) : clearAutoLeave (cfgState cfg lrn) = cfgState

theorem cfgM_eq_simple (cfg lrn : GSet w64) : cfgM cfg lrn = CfgM.simple cfg lrn

def CCNoop (cfg : GSet w64) (t : raftpb.ConfChangeTransition) (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) : Prop
    :=
  ∀ (lrn : GSet w64), (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ lrn → ¬k ∈ cfg) → ccApplyM t ccs (cfgState cfg lrn) = some (cfgState cfg lrn)

theorem cfgFlags_delete_learner (V L : GSet w64) (id : w64) (h : ¬id ∈ V) : GMap.delete id (cfgFlags
    V L) = cfgFlags V (GMap.delete id L)

theorem ccApplyM_v1_noop (cfg : GSet w64) (m : CCV1M) (H : m.nodeId = W64 0) (Hne : cfg ≠ ∅) :
    CCNoop cfg (ccV2Of (CCMsg.v1 m)).fst (ccV2Of (CCMsg.v1 m)).snd

def ccV2Of : CCMsg → raftpb.ConfChangeTransition × List ConfChangeSingleM :=
  match x✝ with
  | CCMsg.v1 m => (W32 0, [{ Type' := m.type, NodeId' := m.nodeId }])
  | CCMsg.v2 m => (m.transition, m.changes)

theorem not_symdiffTooBig_insert (V : GSet w64) (id : w64) : ¬SymdiffTooBig V <[id := ()]>V

theorem ccApplyM_single (cfg lrn lrn' : GSet w64) (c : ConfChangeSingleM) (H : simpleM [c] (cfgState
    cfg lrn) = some (cfgState cfg lrn')) : ccApplyM (W32 0) [c] (cfgState cfg lrn) = some (cfgState
    cfg lrn')

theorem cfgInv_cfgState (cfg lrn : GSet w64) (Hd : ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ lrn → ¬k ∈ cfg) : CfgInv
    (cfgState cfg lrn)

theorem gset_lookup_none (L : GSet w64) (id : w64) (h : ¬id ∈ L) : L !! id = none

theorem applyOne_outgoing (c : ConfChangeSingleM) (s s' : CCState) (h : applyOne c s = some s') :
    s'.cfg.outgoing = s.cfg.outgoing

theorem cfgFlags_delete_voter (V L : GSet w64) (id : w64) (h : ¬id ∈ L) : GMap.delete id (cfgFlags V
    L) = cfgFlags (GMap.delete id V) L

theorem not_symdiffTooBig_delete (V : GSet w64) (id : w64) : ¬SymdiffTooBig V (GMap.delete id V)

theorem cfgFlags_insert_voter (V L : GSet w64) (id : w64) (h : ¬id ∈ L) : <[id := false]>(cfgFlags V
    L) = cfgFlags (<[id := ()]>V) L

def cfgFlags (cfg lrn : GSet w64) : GMap w64 Bool :=
  GMap.fmap (fun x => false) cfg ∪ GMap.fmap (fun x => true) lrn

def CCShrink (cfg : GSet w64) (t : raftpb.ConfChangeTransition) (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ (lrn : GSet w64),
    (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ lrn → ¬k ∈ cfg) → ∃ lrn', lrn' ⊆ lrn ∧ ccApplyM t ccs (cfgState cfg lrn) = some (cfgState cfg lrn')

theorem simpleM_cfgState_addNode (V L : GSet w64) (id : w64) (hid : id ≠ W64 0) (hL : ¬id ∈ L) (Hd :
    ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ L → ¬k ∈ V) : simpleM [addNodeCC id] (cfgState V L) = some (cfgState (<[id :=
    ()]>V) L)

def ccApplyM (t : raftpb.ConfChangeTransition) (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) (s : CCState) : Option
    CCState :=
  if t = W32 0 ∧ ccs = [] then leaveJointM s
  else
    match enterJointOf t ccs.length with
    | some (al, true) => enterJointM al ccs s
    | some (fst, false) => simpleM ccs s
    | none => none

theorem cfgFlags_mem (cfg lrn : GSet w64) (k : w64) : k ∈ cfgFlags cfg lrn ↔ k ∈ cfg ∨ k ∈ lrn

theorem applyCC_of_shrink (cfg : GSet w64) {V : Type} (prs : GMap w64 V) (t :
    raftpb.ConfChangeTransition) (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) (H : CCShrink cfg t ccs) (Hsub : cfg
    ⊆ prs.domSet) (Hsz : ↑prs.size ≤ 2 ^ 62) : ∃ lrn', (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ lrn' → ¬k ∈ cfg) ∧ ↑(cfg ∪
    lrn').size ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧ ccApplyM t ccs (cfgState cfg (prs.domSet \ cfg)) = some (cfgState cfg
    lrn') ∧ ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ lrn' → k ∈ prs.domSet

def cfgM (cfg lrn : GSet w64) : CfgM :=
  { incoming := cfg, outgoing := ∅, learners := lrn, learnersNext := ∅, autoLeave := false }

theorem simpleM_cfgState_removeVoter (V L : GSet w64) (c : ConfChangeSingleM) (Hty : c.Type' = W32
    1) (h0 : c.NodeId' ≠ W64 0) (hV : c.NodeId' ∈ V) (hne : GMap.delete c.NodeId' V ≠ ∅) (Hd : ∀ (k
    : w64), k ∈ L → ¬k ∈ V) : simpleM [c] (cfgState V L) = some (cfgState (GMap.delete c.NodeId' V)
    L)
